limitations: Hypothesis-driven exploratory lexical census, informed by previously read cases.
Not semantic error rates, sensitivity/specificity, human agreement or a significance test.
No historical availability, question-version, unknown-outcome or forecasting-performance verification.
Empty FRS and no-hit records are not semantic passes; no record is promoted or excluded.

detector_specification.canonicalization: casefold matched text, then collapse all whitespace to one ASCII space
detector_specification.duration_grammar: Digits with optional dot-plus-digits fraction; optional whitespace and ASCII/en dash; fixed unit; stripped fullmatch. Excludes .5, 1., signs, prefixes, suffixes and spelled-out numbers.
detector_specification.interpretation: Exploratory candidate lexical indicators only; not semantic failures or historical/outcome verification.
detector_specification.matching: Scan fields separately; offsets are Python character offsets within the named field. Never join fields.

rules.duration_horizon_with_claim_cue: stripped duration fullmatch AND a claim cue exists
rules.support_cue_absent_from_claim: at least one support cue canonical key absent from all claim and horizon cue keys
rules.unspecified_horizon_with_claim_cue: stripped casefolded horizon == unspecified AND a claim cue exists
